main_text.head: INDEX SECTIONUM.
main_text.l: I. | Materia hujus scripti, ejúsque Methodus. 1.
II. | Occasio disceptationis de Eucharistia Viri doctissimi, 8.
V. | Non esse Zuinglii commentum, ESSE Ponì pro SIGNIFICAT. 30.
VI. | De sensu verborum, Hoc est corpus meum, Tropico, seu figurato, 53.
VII. | Transsubstantiationi nec Scripturam patrocinari, nec Rationem, nec Antiquitatem, 62.

page.notes: The scan is a printed page with a list in two columns (numeral left, entry right). The line "VIII." at lower right is set apart and is printed without an entry. Some letters in the italic entries are uncertain. The "Ponì" reading in entry V is doubtful and may be "Ponit" or similar. The "Hoc" and "Tropico" words in entry VI are in mixed type. Spacing of the numbers is printed as is.
